name: Tin Duelist
description: Duel a wind-up rival using spacing, guard and committed attacks.
natural_language: Win the duel: deplete the copper rival’s health, or have more health at the bell. A tie loses. Walk, guard, and choose jab, lunge or guard-breaking hammer; attacks commit you through winding, strike and recovery. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or other implementation or hidden-state access. Stay in this task tab; only visible task controls in task-created tabs are allowed.

metadata.notes: Original wind-up duel grounded in FightingICE move phases and spacing. Automated evidence is separate from human calibration.
